title: The Joyful Parade
reflectionQuestion: If you had been there, waving a palm branch in the happy crowd, what do you think it would have felt like?
kidSafetyNotes: PURE joy/celebration -- deliberately NO foreshadowing of the cross (this is the parade, kept festive). The gentle king on a little donkey (humble, not a war horse). Kid title 'The Joyful Parade'. One image: the sea of green palms + coats on the road. James Husky is a bright 'good' voice (no de-bloom).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: The multitudes who went in front of him, and those who followed, kept shouting, “Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”
